subject: CAIQ alignment decision log & evidence batch  Cloud Assurance mapping
messages:
From: Isabel Moreno <isabel.moreno@stratacorp.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.reynolds@stratacorp.com
Date: 2027-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ scope clarification + mapping ask for Redwood

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for taking this on. StrataCorp is consolidating CAIQ responses for the procurement review next month and we need: a) a clear control crosswalk to your product (hosted + dedicated), b) a decision log for controls where Redwood relies on third parties, and c) an evidence bundle for a first-pass review.

Can you confirm the scope we discussed (hosted API + Dedicated pools, exclude Private on-prem package for now) and share a timeline for a deliverable we can hand to our security team? If you have a matrix mapping question IDs to control owners, that would be ideal.

Also: preferred format is a single ZIP with an index (spreadsheet) and file-level proofs. If there's an SSO or Drive link you prefer, share it.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Isabel Moreno
Sr. Security PM, StrataCorp

Attachment: CAIQ_2027_questions_v2.xlsx (XLSX)

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Isabel Moreno <isabel.moreno@stratacorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope clarification + mapping ask for Redwood

Hi Isabel —

Confirmed: scope is Hosted API (public API endpoints) + Dedicated (reserved GPU pools). We'll exclude Private deployments and marketplace integrations for this pass.

Planned deliverables:
- CAIQ decision log (spreadsheet) that records: question ID, Redwood assertion, evidence file(s), owner, dependency flag (internal/third-party), and remediation note if "partial".
- Evidence bundle (ZIP) with docs + redacted runtime snippets where appropriate.
- Control mapping (matrix CSV) for quick ingest.

Timeline: initial drop by 2027-05-25 EOD Pacific. If your team needs an interim extract earlier, say which control families you want first (e.g., Identity, Logging, Network).

I attached a blank template and will ask Kim and Marcus to fill owner rows and attach artifacts.

Priyom Das
Sr. Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-caiq-template.xlsx (XLSX)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-23T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope clarification + mapping ask for Redwood

Thanks Priyom — quick notes on owner mapping and evidence approach:

- Identity/Access (QID: ID-*) => Owner: IAM team (kimberly_park). Evidence: SSO SAML metadata, Okta role map export (csv), access review cadence doc.
- Logging/Monitoring (QID: LOG-*) => Owner: Observability (marcus_lin). Evidence: sample telemetry export (last 30 days), retention policy, runbook screenshots.
- Network & Segmentation (QID: NET-*) => Owner: Infrastructure (lauren_bishop). Evidence: VPC diagrams, firewall rule snapshots, peering configs (redacted).

A couple of decisions we should capture in the decision log:
1) We treat telemetry collected at inference time as ephemeral (30-day retention) and therefore point to retention policy rather than full log dumps.
2) For Dedicated pools, customer-managed keys are supported via KMS integrations; when a customer opts in, encryption-at-rest evidence is partly in customer account (mark as "customer-scoped dependency").

I'll collect the owner attachments into the evidence bundle. Marcus — can you confirm the sample telemetry file and a short readme for redaction (so we don't leak customer prompts)?

Kimberly Park
Engineering, Identity & Access Controls
Redwood Inference

Attachment: owner-rollup-notes.md (TXT)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Isabel Moreno <isabel.moreno@stratacorp.com>, priyom_das@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-25T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ deliverable: decision log + evidence bundle (initial)

Isabel / Tom —

Attached is our initial CAIQ deliverable pack. Highlights and caveats are listed below. This is the first-pass package and is intended for your security team to triage:

Highlights:
- redwood-caiq-decision-log-v1.xlsx: full crosswalk (QID -> assertion -> owner -> evidence pointer -> dependency flag).
- evidence-index-20270525.zip: all artifacts we own + sanitized runtime snippets.
- network-diagram.pdf: high-level VPC/segmentation diagram (no customer data).

Caveats / notes:
- Several questions are marked "partial" where evidence requires customer-specific artifacts (Dedicated KMS keys). Those lines are flagged in the decision log and include a recommended ask for procurement.
- Telemetry samples are redacted as agreed — redaction README is included in the ZIP.
- We did not include Private (on-prem) artifacts per scope. If you expand scope, we will need additional time to gather vendor attestations.

Next steps / asks for StrataCorp:
1) Please confirm receipt and whether you want a compact CSV or an index-only package for ingestion into your assessment tool.
2) If you require notarized or signed copies, indicate the controls and we'll route to Legal.

Deliverables attached here and uploaded to Drive (link above).


Lauren Bishop
Principal Infrastructure Engineer (Network)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-caiq-decision-log-v1.xlsx (XLSX); evidence-index-20270525.zip (ZIP); network-diagram.pdf (PDF)
